seriesTitle: The Real Wolf of Wall Street

episodes.title: Too Much Is Never Enough
episodes.summary: Before the movie, Jordan Belfort builds a fraud empire… until the FBI starts watching.

episodes.title: More Money, More Problems
episodes.summary: Jordan is rich, married, and seems to have it all until the government sets its sights on his firm.

episodes.title: Truth and Consequences
episodes.summary: Jordan's empire falls, but he again rises as an icon of wealth, debauchery, and the American Dream.
